Security policy

Supported versions

Only the most recent released build of Vodka and the current main branch receive fixes. Fixes land on main and are included in the next release.

Version Supported
Most recent release yes
main (unreleased) yes
Older releases no

Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report the vulnerability privately through GitHub: https://github.com/rolling7ho/vodka-stack/security/advisories/new

Include the following information:

  • the affected component (Vodka application, OpenV, winecx, dxmt or build scripts);
  • the affected version, the macOS version and the Mac model;
  • reproduction steps or a proof of concept;
  • the impact, meaning what an attacker gains and what access is required;
  • any suggested fix.

You will receive an initial response within one week. Allow time for a fix to be released before publishing; credit will be given in the advisory unless you prefer otherwise.

Scope

In scope:

  • the Vodka application and its helper targets (apps/vodka/);
  • OpenV and its exported ABI (apps/openv/);
  • patches in engine/winecx/ and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/;
  • build, release and update infrastructure in this repository;
  • the Sparkle update path and appcast handling.

Out of scope:

  • GTA Online, anti-cheat bypasses and cheating in multiplayer games, which are explicitly unsupported;
  • vulnerabilities in third-party games, mods or launchers;
  • reports that require an already-compromised Mac;
  • dependency issues already fixed upstream. Report those upstream and inform the maintainers afterwards.

Safe harbour

The maintainers will not pursue legal action for good-faith security research that respects this policy, avoids privacy violations and data destruction, and allows reasonable time to respond before disclosure.

Vodka Stack and the Vodka application are licensed under GPL-3.0. OpenV is MIT; the engine sources are LGPL-2.1-or-later.
